scope: Real-case review: bounded source listing, byte-preserving SDK edits, result naming and selected-run reporting
findings: ComprehensiveTool1 list_source returned 130837 characters in one tool result; no candidate was produced before token admission stopped the run.
SDK universal-newline conversion inflated BookRead2 and Calendar1 patches to whole-file changes.
changes: Source listing defaults to 50 paths, maximum 100, with component-prefix filtering and explicit continuation; shared strategy prefers stack paths and symbol search.
SDK remains the authorized exact-edit backend. The adapter verifies its normalized replacement and retains original bytes outside the anchor and the original newline style.
Existing 016/022 exports renamed to descriptive lower-case case folders; README rerun paths and their file-manifest entries updated. Original task/run identities and evidence ZIPs remain unchanged.
Unusable 017/case17 and B1/case04 exports moved to ignored archive. The final results table selects one effective run per case, excluding archived troubleshooting costs.
After the 26 cases, evaluate missing-data, malformed-log, format-variation and domain-shift inputs separately. Formal submission rewriting remains deferred.
initial_checks: Three older workspace assertions assumed normalized LF; updated to compare against original baseline bytes, without changing the required SDK edit or rollback behavior.
One light integration run was rejected after task_strategy.py changed during the test; fixed by holding host sources constant for the complete test.
The next integration run exceeded its 120-second timeout. A fixed-source rerun completed all three tests under a 300-second task allowance within the unchanged managed resource limits.
Ruff found an unused _files import after pagination; removed and rechecked.
environment: Reused the existing project Python and locked dependencies. No installation, platform SDK, model weights, global settings or resource limits changed.
limitations: Software checks do not prove real-model repair quality. Three admitted source cases passed their declared local scope; analysis cases remain unverified. Remaining real cases and robustness matrix still pending.
